items.title: Team Lead

highlights: Architected visual call flow builders using React Flow, TypeScript, and Vite, allowing enterprise test engineers to visually design, inspect, and debug intricate multi-branch IVR paths.

Established frontend architectural standards, modular component libraries, and strict pull request review criteria across distributed engineering squads.
Spearheaded frontend performance optimizations for high-density tree visualizations and large test datasets, reducing client-side memory overhead by 35%.

items.title: Lead Software Engineer
items.summary: Led frontend architecture on a high-throughput fintech SaaS platform delivering real-time financial portfolio analytics and automated transaction execution for global brands.

Engineered server-side rendering and multi-tier data caching strategies, reducing First Contentful Paint by 40% and maintaining flawless Core Web Vitals across complex financial views.
Mentored frontend developers through weekly architectural reviews, unit testing standards, and best practices for resilient client-side state management.

items.title: Senior Software Developer
items.summary: Spearheaded the complete modernization of an enterprise healthcare product, transitioning a legacy Grails monolith into an installable, high-performance React Progressive Web Application.
highlights: Led end-to-end migration into a responsive React PWA with service worker caching, ensuring reliable offline access to patient charts for medical practitioners in low-connectivity clinics.
Built custom real-time biometric telemetry dashboards using Chart.js, rendering continuous blood pressure, ECG, and glucose data smoothly on low-powered mobile hardware.
Authored a shared, accessible React component library with Semantic UI and custom CSS, eliminating redundant code and cutting new feature delivery times in half.

items.title: Front-End Developer
items.summary: Engineered scalable, mission-critical web applications for prominent international media and technology clients including IFLScience and TIPLL.
highlights: Delivered high-performance frontend interfaces for IFLScience, serving millions of monthly active readers with optimized asset bundling and zero layout shift during dynamic ad delivery.
Built interactive geospatial location finder applications integrating Google Maps APIs, Highcharts, RxJS, and Redux for real-time venue discovery.
Structured complex asynchronous state machines with RxJS and Redux Thunk, preventing redundant network requests and ensuring predictable UI state during rapid user interaction.

items.title: Front-End Developer
items.summary: Built scalable web applications and enterprise portals using Angular, React, Express.js, and LoopBack for diverse commercial clients.
highlights: Developed responsive single-page applications with Angular and React, integrating RESTful microservices with optimistic UI state updates and robust error boundaries.
Implemented normalized state architectures using Redux and RxJS, decreasing API roundtrips across multi-step enterprise workflows.
Refactored legacy styling into modular SASS architecture, defining global theme variables and utility mixins that accelerated team development velocity.

items.title: Freelance Web Developer

Focused on mobile-first responsive interfaces, rapid page load times, SEO optimization, and clean semantic markup.

items.summary: Collaborated in an agile team developing commercial multi-tenant invoicing and financial reporting platforms.
highlights: Engineered dynamic invoice creation and billing workflows with asynchronous Ajax validation, automated tax computation, and server-side PDF exports.
Guaranteed cross-browser rendering consistency and responsive layouts across legacy enterprise browsers and modern mobile viewports.

highlights: Processed complex technical manuscripts, mathematical notation, and IEEE journal archives, ensuring strict compliance with international digital publishing standards.
Developed automated validation routines to verify schema integrity and metadata accuracy prior to publisher distribution.
